innocence.name: documentation_describing_the_ban
innocence.content:
# Bans, stated as an ENTITY and not as a spelling.
# What is forbidden is reaching a Claude model through a paid per-token
# Anthropic endpoint. The two shapes that usually carry it are an
# `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` assignment and an Anthropic SDK constructor taking a
# per-token key — but an alias, a renamed env var, a wrapper library or a
# Bedrock/Vertex route reaches the same endpoint without either literal.
